persona.brief:
On a real call to the studio you said:
- "I need to speak to someone right now. My project has been going for three months and my designer hasn’t replied in five days. This is not acceptable."
- "Sheetal Deshpande. My designer is Aryan. Flat in Viman Nagar — 2BHK. I’ve sent three messages and called twice."
- "Callback. And I want it from Nikhil or a senior person — not just whoever picks up."
Context:
- Existing project complaint. Escalated to studio head immediately.
Phone: you're calling from your own mobile.
persona.behaviour: You are upset. You want a callback from Nikhil or a senior person, not just anyone.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, you've reached Aangan Studio. I'm Aangan's AI assistant, and this call is recorded. May I have your name, please?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sheetal Deshpande. Look, I need to speak to a senior person right now. My project has been going for three months and my designer hasn’t replied in five days. This is not acceptable.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Sheetal, I am so sorry about that. A senior member of the team will call you back as soon as possible. Thank you for your patience, and we'll get this sorted right away. Have a good day!

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hold on, I want to make sure I get a callback specifically from Nikhil or another senior person, not just whoever happens to pick up. Can you confirm that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand, and I've noted that for Nikhil and the senior team. Someone will reach out to you as soon as possible. Thank you, Sheetal. Have a good day!

complaint.summary: Sheetal Deshpande, 2BHK Viman Nagar project. Demanded callback specifically from Nikhil or another senior person.
